description: This file implements Bluetooth HCI raw mode handling, including buffer management, driver registration, and command processing for the Zephyr RTOS Bluetooth stack.

methods.name: bt_hci_driver_register
methods.description: Registers an HCI driver if none is registered and the driver has open and send functions.

methods.name: bt_buf_get_rx
methods.description: Allocates a receive buffer of specified type with a timeout.

methods.name: bt_buf_get_tx
methods.description: Allocates a transmit buffer of specified type, with optional data, handling H4 protocol types.

methods.name: bt_buf_get_evt
methods.description: Gets an event buffer for a specific event type.

methods.name: bt_recv
methods.description: Processes received buffer, sends to monitor, and queues for raw reception.

methods.name: bt_recv_prio
methods.description: Processes priority events, avoiding duplicate queuing.

methods.name: bt_send
methods.description: Sends a buffer, handling command extensions and ECC if enabled.

methods.name: bt_hci_raw_set_mode
methods.description: Sets the raw mode (passthrough or H4).

methods.name: bt_hci_raw_cmd_ext_register
methods.description: Registers command extensions for raw mode.

methods.name: bt_enable_raw
methods.description: Enables raw mode with a specified receive queue, opening the driver.
